clues.text: Delilah lulled this Nazirite to sleep on her lap and called a man to shave off his seven braids.
Near the vineyards of Timnah, the Spirit of the LORD came on him and he tore apart a roaring young lion.
At Lehi the ropes fell from his arms, and he struck down a thousand Philistines with a donkey's jawbone.
Blind and mocked, he pushed two central pillars and brought a Philistine temple down on its lords.
After his wife was given away, he tied torches to three hundred foxes and burned the Philistines' grain.
At midnight in Gaza, he pulled up the city gate doors and posts and carried them toward Hebron.
At his wedding feast he gave thirty Philistines a riddle about something sweet coming out of the strong.
